messages:
Carla: starting a bring-up thread for Patron's adapter_v3 (LoRA). Plan: merge lora into base-3b, run 4/8-bit quant smoke, run quick-eval pack (summaries + legal q/a + instruction clarity). Want compatibility checks for kv-cache and past_key_value shape changes. pinging eng-ml for owners. :eyes:

Alice: on it. saw one merge conflict in merge/lora-patron -> layer_norm param name mismatch. i'll push a fix by EOD.

Ben: what's baseline? full-finetune or previous adapter_v2? need perf numbers to compare.

Carla: baseline = adapter_v2 (patron_v2). Metrics we care: rouge-l, exact-match, hallucination-rate (heuristic), latency p50/p95 on 8k context. I'll drop eval pack link.

Dana: quick results from local smoke on small set: adapter_v3 raw -> rouge-l 0.42 vs 0.44 baseline, em 0.61 vs 0.63, hallucination up ~1.8%. p50 210ms 4-bit q slow? attached logs.

Dana:
```
quant: 4bit
batch: 1
seq: 1024
p50: 210ms
p95: 470ms
rouge-l: 0.42
em: 0.61
hall_rate: 0.072
```

Alice: hmm 4-bit path shows minor quality drop. can we try per-channel scale vs symmetric quant? Also check matmul kernel selection; runtime switches kernels for 4-bit which may change fusion and precision.

Ben: also run merge-compat test: run 100 inferences with KV reuse and compare outputs to baseline tolerance 1e-3 normalized edit distance.

Carla: yes. added job to ci: patron-lora-merge-compat. pinging infra for GPU pool assignment.

DeployBot: CI started: job patron-lora-merge-compat #1423 -> https://ci/redwood/1423 :gear:

Dana: after enabling per-channel scale and 8-bit quant i see rouge-l 0.44 close to baseline, p50 260ms, p95 520ms. tradeoff looks acceptable. attaching eval deltas.

Alice: i'll open PR with two configs: 4bit-perchannel and 8bit-symmetric. also adding fallback policy to route to 8bit when quality reg detected.

Ben: suggest adding golden set tests for legal Q/A to catch hallucination regressions in canary. add to quick-eval pack.

Carla: agreed. schedule canary in dedicated pool tomorrow. thanks all :thumbsup:
